people.name: Julius Shulman
people.extract: Julius Shulman was an American architectural photographer best known for his photograph "Case Study House #22, Los Angeles, 1960. Pierre Koenig, Architect." The house is also known as the Stahl House. Shulman's photography spread the aesthetic of California's Mid-century modern architecture around the world. Through his many books, exhibits and personal appearances his work ushered in a new appreciation for the movement beginning in the 1990s.
highlights: Spread California's Mid-century modern architecture aesthetic.

people.name: Troy Tulowitzki
people.extract: Troy Trevor Tulowitzki, nicknamed "Tulo", is an American professional baseball coach and former shortstop who played 13 seasons in Major League Baseball (MLB), primarily with the Colorado Rockies. He also played for the Toronto Blue Jays and New York Yankees. Tulowitzki is currently an assistant baseball coach for the Texas Longhorns.
highlights: Former MLB shortstop, primarily with Colorado Rockies.
Played 13 seasons in Major League Baseball.
Currently assistant baseball coach for Texas Longhorns.
